title: The Rutting Elk
text: Two great elk lock antlers in the clearing, bellowing, steam pouring from their nostrils, hooves tearing the earth. Too lost in their fight to notice you. One is bleeding badly from the neck. Shed antlers lie in the churned mud between them.

outcomes.text: The loser limps away. The winner bellows at you, and goes, and its challenge stays in your blood.

options.label: The quickest snatches a shed antler from between them.

outcomes.text: A fine antler, and no harm done.

options.label: Bring one down while they are busy.

outcomes.text: Meat for the road, and the other elk charges.
